patch_description: The current search spends many rounds generating large neighborhoods and uses a mostly fixed mix of two-switches and rotations. This version bounds neighborhood generation, adds multi-switch kicks, and adapts the sampling mix according to which move types actually improve LP scores. It evaluates five diverse proposals per round, favoring low-energy moves while reserving slots for exploration. A compact elite-and-diversity archive, occasional uphill acceptance, and bottleneck-focused moves aim to balance exploitation with escape from local optima while keeping the LP budget productive.
